## Theoretical limit T (PATHWAYS v3.1)

> T is a hyper-optimistic theoretical limit (thought experiment): all assumptions at full strength from 1 January 2027, combining best observed attributes of different buildings and places; not a proposal or a feasible pathway (potentials hierarchy: theoretical > technical > realisable).

T = P5-stretch (L3 removals -40%; no L4; L1, L2a / L2b and L5 replaced by T2, T1 and T4) with the overrides below, all at full strength from 1 January 2027 (no ramp); 2026 observed and untouched. BAU decarbonisation applies in T as in every run (A1-A3 item paths of Horup et al. 2025, A4-A5 e^(-0.01 (t - 2025)); the lift held at 2025 as in the baseline). Sensitivity (SI): the same T on the logistic ramp (T-ramp).
